tamgaUrl.title: Tamga URL
tamgaUrl.description: Base URL of your Tamga proxy, for example https://tamga.internal. https only, except for localhost. The extension calls POST <URL>/api/v1/scan and nothing else.

tamgaKey.title: Tamga key
tamgaKey.description: A Tamga key of the proxy scope, sent as X-Tamga-Key. Use one key per group of browsers: the scan limit is counted per key.

failMode.title: When Tamga cannot be asked
failMode.description: closed (the default): a message is held until it has been checked. open: it is sent unchecked and the person is told.

autoRedact.title: Replace text without asking
autoRedact.description: false (the default): the redacted text is shown and the person chooses to use it. true: it replaces the original straight away and the person is told.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: The sites the extension acts on. All three when left out.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout in milliseconds
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Tamga before the check counts as failed. 2500 when left out; kept between 500 and 10000.
